description: Research results cache. Prospect Researcher writes, Outreach Writer and Content Writer read. Prevents re-researching the same company.

entry_format.product_summary: string (what the product does, who it serves)
entry_format.workflow_complexity: low | medium | high (how complex are their users' workflows?)
entry_format.ai_features_observed: string (what AI they already have, if any)
entry_format.competitive_landscape: string (who competes, who's AI-native in their space)
pain_signals: string (specific signs of workflow friction or AI uncertainty)
personalization_hooks: string (specific things to reference in outreach)
entry_format.fit_assessment: string (why they are or aren't a fit)
entry_format.recommended_angle: string (which outreach angle to lead with)
